internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Latency and Error Rate in Cart Service
internal.body:
At 11:58 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high error rates in the cart service. Initial diagnosis at 12:18 UTC identified elevated p95 latency of 0.25 seconds and increased error rates, indicating latency and error injection issues. A mitigation action was approved and executed promptly to disable the 'cartFailure' flag, which was correlated with the service degradation. Recovery was verified immediately after, with latency metrics returning to normal levels (0.12 seconds p95).

Timeline:
- 11:58 UTC: Alert received for high error rate in cart service.
- 12:18 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed latency and error injection issues.
- 12:18 UTC: Mitigation action to disable 'cartFailure' flag approved and executed.
- 12:18 UTC: Recovery verified with normalized latency metrics.

The incident was resolved successfully with no ongoing impact.
